name: bento-browser
description: Bento Browser — a Firefox-based browser built with @bento-browser/surfer (fork of @zen-browser/surfer).

scripts.import: node scripts/generate-chrome-tokens.mjs && bash scripts/reset-engine-patches.sh && surfer import && bash scripts/append-prefs.sh && bash scripts/sync-builtin-addon-symlinks.sh
scripts.build: pnpm run ext:build && pnpm run import && surfer build
scripts.dev: pnpm run ext:build && pnpm run import && mkdir -p .bento-dev-profile && rm -rf .bento-dev-profile/startupCache && MOZ_PURGE_CACHES=1 engine/obj-aarch64-apple-darwin25.4.0/dist/Bento.app/Contents/MacOS/bento --new-instance --jsdebugger --profile .bento-dev-profile
scripts.dev:fresh: pnpm run ext:build && pnpm run import && engine/obj-aarch64-apple-darwin25.4.0/dist/Bento.app/Contents/MacOS/bento --new-instance --jsdebugger --profile $(mktemp -d)
